text: Under `numactl --cpunodebind=1 --membind=1`, michi 0.2.0 leases only node 1 cores, since `Cores::read` builds its pool from sched_getaffinity. On 21 Oct 2026 a 1-thread nail and its mmseqs child had Cpus_allowed_list 1, and over 99% of their memory sat on node 1 per numa_maps. With a one-node pool michi writes no node or policy column and sets no mempolicy.
